## 1. Test Strategy

### 1.1 Test Layers

| Layer | Purpose | Recommended Tools | Coverage Target |
|-------|---------|-------------------|-----------------|
| Unit | Isolated function testing (services, utilities) | Vitest | 80% code coverage |
| Integration | API endpoint testing with database | Supertest + Vitest | 100% endpoints |
| Component | UI component rendering and interaction | Testing Library + Vitest | All stateful components |
| E2E | Full user flow testing | Playwright | All critical paths |

### 1.2 Coverage Targets

| Category | Target | Rationale |
|----------|--------|-----------|
| API Endpoints | 100% of endpoints tested | All 48 endpoints must have at least happy path + primary error case |
| API Response Codes | All documented status codes | Every 2XX, 4XX, 5XX documented in API contract |
| UI Screens | All screens, all states | Loading, default, empty, error states per screen |
| Form Validation | All fields, all rules | Every validation rule in every form |
| User Stories | All acceptance criteria | 1:1 mapping from AC to test requirement |
| Security Flows | 100% auth flows | Login, logout, token expiry, permission checks |

### 1.3 Test Data Strategy

| Data Set | Purpose | Contents |
|----------|---------|----------|
| Seed Data | Development/demo | Demo org, admin/member users, sample project |
| Fixtures | Unit/integration tests | Minimal valid objects for each entity |
| E2E Data | End-to-end scenarios | Complete user journey data (project with sources, mappings, runs) |

## 2. Test Requirements

### 2.1 Authentication Tests (US-AUTH-001 to US-AUTH-004)

#### TR-001: User Registration via Invitation

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-001, AC-001-1, AC-001-2
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/register
- **Preconditions**: Valid invitation token exists in database
- **Test Input**: `{ email, password, name, token }`
- **Expected Result**: User created, JWT returned
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 201
  - [ ] Response contains `token` and `user` object
  - [ ] User record created in database with correct organisation_id
  - [ ] Invitation marked as accepted (acceptedAt set)
  - [ ] Password is hashed (not plaintext in DB)

#### TR-002: Registration with Invalid Token

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-001
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/register
- **Preconditions**: None
- **Test Input**: `{ email, password, name, token: "invalid" }`
- **Expected Result**: Registration fails with 404
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 404
  - [ ] Error code is INVITATION_NOT_FOUND
  - [ ] No user record created

#### TR-003: Registration with Expired Token

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-001
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/register
- **Preconditions**: Invitation exists with expiresAt in the past
- **Test Input**: `{ email, password, name, token }`
- **Expected Result**: Registration fails with 422
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 422
  - [ ] Error code is INVITATION_EXPIRED

#### TR-004: User Login with Valid Credentials

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-002, AC-002-1
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/login
- **Preconditions**: User exists with known password
- **Test Input**: `{ email: "admin@demo.com", password: "password123" }`
- **Expected Result**: Login successful, JWT returned
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 200
  - [ ] Response contains `token` with valid JWT
  - [ ] Response contains `user` object with id, email, name, role
  - [ ] User lastLoginAt updated in database

#### TR-005: User Login with Invalid Credentials

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-002, AC-002-2
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/login
- **Preconditions**: User exists
- **Test Input**: `{ email: "admin@demo.com", password: "wrongpassword" }`
- **Expected Result**: Login fails without revealing which field was wrong
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 401
  - [ ] Error code is INVALID_CREDENTIALS
  - [ ] Error message does not reveal whether email or password was wrong

#### TR-006: User Logout

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-003, AC-003-1
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/logout
- **Preconditions**: Valid JWT token
- **Test Input**: Authorization header with valid token
- **Expected Result**: Logout successful
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 200
  - [ ] Subsequent requests with same token fail (if token blacklisting implemented)

#### TR-007: Password Reset Request

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-004, AC-004-1, AC-004-2
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/forgot-password
- **Preconditions**: User exists
- **Test Input**: `{ email: "admin@demo.com" }`
- **Expected Result**: Reset token created (email sent if service available)
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 200
  - [ ] password_reset_tokens record created with 1-hour expiry
  - [ ] Same response for non-existent email (security)

#### TR-008: Password Reset with Valid Token

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-004, AC-004-3
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/reset-password
- **Preconditions**: Valid reset token exists
- **Test Input**: `{ token, newPassword }`
- **Expected Result**: Password updated
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 200
  - [ ] User can login with new password
  - [ ] Reset token marked as used

#### TR-009: Password Reset with Expired Token

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-004, AC-004-4
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/reset-password
- **Preconditions**: Reset token exists with expiresAt in past
- **Test Input**: `{ token, newPassword }`
- **Expected Result**: Reset fails
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 422
  - [ ] Error code is TOKEN_EXPIRED or INVITATION_EXPIRED

#### TR-010: Session Persistence (7-day JWT)

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-002, AC-002-3
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: JWT token validation
- **Preconditions**: JWT issued with 7-day expiry
- **Test Input**: Token with exp claim 7 days from issue
- **Expected Result**: Token valid for duration
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Token contains exp claim 7 days from iat
  - [ ] Token accepted by protected endpoints during validity period

### 2.2 Organization Management Tests (US-ORG-001 to US-ORG-003)

#### TR-011: List Organization Users (Admin)

- **Traces to**: US-ORG-001, AC-ORG-001-1
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: GET /api/users
- **Preconditions**: Admin user authenticated, multiple users exist
- **Test Input**: Authorization header with admin token
- **Expected Result**: List of all org users
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 200
  - [ ] Response contains array of users with name, email, role, createdAt

#### TR-012: List Users as Member (Forbidden)

- **Traces to**: US-ORG-001
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: GET /api/users
- **Preconditions**: Member user authenticated
- **Test Input**: Authorization header with member token
- **Expected Result**: Access denied
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 403
  - [ ] Error code is ADMIN_REQUIRED

#### TR-013: Invite User to Organization

- **Traces to**: US-AUTH-001, AC-001-1

- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/users/invite
- **Preconditions**: Admin user authenticated

- **Expected Result**: Invitation created
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 201
  - [ ] Invitation record created with unique token
  - [ ] Invitation has 7-day expiry

#### TR-014: Remove User (Admin)

- **Traces to**: US-ORG-002, AC-ORG-002-1
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: DELETE /api/users/:id
- **Preconditions**: Admin authenticated, target user exists
- **Test Input**: User ID to remove
- **Expected Result**: User soft-deleted
- **Verification Points**:

  - [ ] User isActive set to false
  - [ ] User cannot login after removal

#### TR-015: Prevent Last Admin Removal

- **Traces to**: US-ORG-002, AC-ORG-002-3
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: DELETE /api/users/:id
- **Preconditions**: Only one admin in organization
- **Test Input**: Admin tries to remove themselves
- **Expected Result**: Removal blocked
- **Verification Points**:

#### TR-016: Change User Role

- **Traces to**: US-ORG-003, AC-ORG-003-1, AC-ORG-003-2
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: PATCH /api/users/:id/role
- **Preconditions**: Admin authenticated, target user exists
- **Test Input**: `{ role: "admin" }` or `{ role: "member" }`
- **Expected Result**: Role updated
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 200
  - [ ] User role updated in database
  - [ ] User gains/loses admin capabilities accordingly

### 2.7 De-identification Tests (US-PII-001 to US-PII-004)

#### TR-036: Configure PII Detection Rules

- **Traces to**: US-PII-001, AC-PII-001-1, AC-PII-001-2
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: PUT /api/projects/:id/privacy
- **Preconditions**: Project exists
- **Test Input**: `{ detectNames: true, detectEmails: true, ... }`
- **Expected Result**: Privacy config saved
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 200
  - [ ] Privacy config persisted
  - [ ] Individual PII type toggles saved

#### TR-037: Consistent Entity Replacement

- **Traces to**: US-PII-002, AC-PII-002-1, AC-PII-002-2, AC-PII-002-3
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: Processing engine de-identification
- **Preconditions**: Source data with repeated names
- **Test Input**: Data containing "John Smith" 5 times
- **Expected Result**: All instances replaced consistently
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Same name always maps to same placeholder
  - [ ] Different names get different placeholders
  - [ ] Entity mappings stored in entity_mappings table

#### TR-038: Create Custom Privacy Rule

- **Traces to**: US-PII-003, AC-PII-003-1, AC-PII-003-2
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/projects/:id/privacy/rules
- **Preconditions**: Project exists
- **Test Input**: `{ name: "Account Numbers", pattern: "ACC-\\d{6}", replacement: "[ACCOUNT]" }`
- **Expected Result**: Rule created
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 201
  - [ ] Rule persisted in privacy_rules table
  - [ ] Pattern applied during processing

#### TR-039: Preview De-identification

- **Traces to**: US-PII-004, AC-PII-004-1, AC-PII-004-2
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/projects/:id/privacy/preview
- **Preconditions**: Project has sources and privacy config
- **Test Input**: Sample size limit
- **Expected Result**: Sample with de-identification applied
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 200
  - [ ] Original and de-identified versions shown
  - [ ] PII replaced according to config

  - [ ] Report includes PII types detected and counts
  - [ ] Report includes rule configurations applied

- **Type**: Integration

- **Expected Result**: List of activity logs

#### TR-054: Filter Activity Logs

- **Traces to**: US-AUD-002, AC-AUD-002-2, AC-AUD-002-3

### 2.12 API Contract Tests

#### TR-055: Health Endpoint

- **Traces to**: System, Replit Deployment
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: GET /api/health
- **Preconditions**: Server running
- **Test Input**: None
- **Expected Result**: Health status
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 200
  - [ ] Response is exactly `{ "status": "ok", "timestamp": "<ISO8601>" }`
  - [ ] No additional fields

#### TR-056: Invalid ID Parameter Handling

- **Traces to**: API Contract validation requirements
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: All parameterized endpoints
- **Preconditions**: Server running
- **Test Input**: Invalid IDs: "abc", -1, 0, 1.5
- **Expected Result**: 400 error with INVALID_ID
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] All invalid ID formats return 400
  - [ ] Error code is INVALID_ID
  - [ ] Message describes the issue

#### TR-057: Unauthorized Access

- **Traces to**: API Contract auth requirements
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: All protected endpoints
- **Preconditions**: No auth token provided
- **Test Input**: Request without Authorization header
- **Expected Result**: 401 error
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] Response status is 401
  - [ ] Error code is UNAUTHORIZED

#### TR-058: Rate Limiting (Auth Endpoints)

- **Traces to**: API Contract rate limiting
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: POST /api/auth/login
- **Preconditions**: None
- **Test Input**: 6+ requests within 1 minute
- **Expected Result**: Rate limit applied
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] First 5 requests succeed or fail normally
  - [ ] 6th+ request returns 429
  - [ ] Error code is RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
  - [ ] X-RateLimit-* headers present

#### TR-059: Error Response Format Consistency

- **Traces to**: API Contract error format
- **Type**: Integration
- **Component Under Test**: All error responses
- **Preconditions**: Various error conditions
- **Test Input**: Requests that trigger errors
- **Expected Result**: Consistent error envelope
- **Verification Points**:
  - [ ] All errors match: `{ "error": { "code": "<CODE>", "message": "<msg>" } }`
  - [ ] No flat `{ "error": "message" }` format
  - [ ] Error codes from ERROR_CODES registry

## 4. Deployment Specification

### 4.1 Environment Variables

| Variable | Classification | Format | Description | Default |
|----------|---------------|--------|-------------|---------|
| DATABASE_URL | REQUIRED | postgres://... | Neon PostgreSQL connection string | None |
| JWT_SECRET | REQUIRED | 32+ char string | Token signing secret | None |
| SESSION_SECRET | REQUIRED | 32+ char string | Session encryption secret | None |
| RESEND_API_KEY | OPTIONAL | re_... | Email service API key | None |
| NODE_ENV | REQUIRED_WITH_DEFAULT | development/production | Environment mode | development |
| PORT | REQUIRED_WITH_DEFAULT | Integer | Server port | 5000 |

**Classification Legend:**
- REQUIRED: Server fails to start if missing
- REQUIRED_WITH_DEFAULT: Has fallback value, documented default applies
- OPTIONAL: Feature disabled if missing (graceful degradation)

### 4.2 Replit-Specific Issue Verification

#### Issue 1: Database Driver Verification
- [ ] Using `postgres` package (postgres-js), NOT @neondatabase/serverless
- [ ] Adapter is `drizzle-orm/postgres-js`, NOT drizzle-orm/neon-http
- [ ] No imports from @neondatabase/* anywhere in codebase

**Verification:** `grep -r "@neondatabase" server/` returns NO results

#### Issue 2: Tailwind CSS v4 Syntax Verification
- [ ] client/src/index.css uses `@import "tailwindcss"` (NOT @tailwind directives)
- [ ] CSS variables defined inside `@layer base { :root { ... } }`
- [ ] No `@tailwind base;`, `@tailwind components;`, `@tailwind utilities;`

**Verification:** `grep -r "@tailwind " client/` returns NO results

#### Issue 3: TypeScript/ESM Module Resolution Verification
- [ ] tsconfig.json has `"moduleResolution": "bundler"`
- [ ] tsconfig.json has `"module": "esnext"` or `"module": "NodeNext"`
- [ ] Package.json type field set appropriately

**Verification:** `grep "moduleResolution" tsconfig.json` shows "bundler"

#### Issue 4: Express SPA Routing Verification
- [ ] NO `app.get('*')` catch-all routes for SPA fallback
- [ ] SPA fallback uses middleware pattern instead
- [ ] Specific routes defined before wildcard/fallback

**Verification:** `grep "app.get('\*')" server/` returns NO results

#### Issue 5: Static File Paths Verification
- [ ] Static file paths use `process.cwd()` (NOT `__dirname`)
- [ ] Production serves from `dist/public`
- [ ] Path resolution works in Replit container

**Verification:** `grep "__dirname" server/index.ts` returns NO results

#### Issue 6: Port Configuration Verification
- [ ] server/config/env.ts PORT defaults to `5000` (NOT 3000)
- [ ] vite.config.ts server.port is `5000`
- [ ] vite.config.ts has `host: '0.0.0.0'`
- [ ] vite.config.ts has `allowedHosts: true`
- [ ] vite.config.ts has `strictPort: true`
- [ ] .replit file runs on port 5000

**Verification:** `grep -E "default.*5000" server/config/env.ts` returns match

#### Issue 7: API Prefix Consistency Verification
- [ ] All route registrations use `/api` prefix (NOT `/api/v1`)
- [ ] Frontend API calls use `/api/...` paths
- [ ] Vite proxy configured for `/api` prefix
- [ ] No mixed usage

**Verification:** `grep -r "/api/v1" server/ client/` returns NO results

#### Issue 8: Error Response Format Verification
- [ ] All API errors return: `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }`
- [ ] HTTP status codes match error types
- [ ] Frontend error handler expects nested format
- [ ] No mixed flat and nested formats

**Verification:** Check error middleware returns consistent structure

### 4.3 Deployment Checklist

#### Pre-Deployment
- [ ] All REQUIRED environment variables set in Replit Secrets
- [ ] DATABASE_URL points to production Neon database
- [ ] JWT_SECRET is unique, cryptographically random, 32+ characters
- [ ] SESSION_SECRET is unique, cryptographically random, 32+ characters
- [ ] All 8 Replit-specific issue verifications pass

#### Deployment Steps
1. [ ] Push code to GitHub repository
2. [ ] Connect Replit to GitHub repository
3. [ ] Configure Secrets in Replit (DATABASE_URL, JWT_SECRET, SESSION_SECRET)
4. [ ] Run `npm install`
5. [ ] Run `npm run db:push` (verify no interactive prompts)
6. [ ] Run `npm run build`
7. [ ] Run `npm run start`
8. [ ] Verify health endpoint: GET /api/health returns `{ "status": "ok", "timestamp": "..." }`
9. [ ] Verify frontend loads at root URL
10. [ ] Verify SPA routing works (refresh on non-root page)

#### Health Verification
- [ ] GET /api/health returns 200
- [ ] Response is exactly `{ "status": "ok", "timestamp": "<ISO8601>" }`
- [ ] Database connectivity confirmed (app doesn't crash on start)

### 4.4 Database Migration Verification

| Step | Command | Expected Result |
|------|---------|-----------------|
| 1. Run migrations | `npm run db:push` | Completes without prompts |
| 2. Verify tables | `SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public'` | All 14 entity tables exist |
| 3. Verify indexes | `SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public'` | All defined indexes exist |
| 4. Seed demo data | `npm run db:seed` | Demo org and users created |
| 5. Test login | POST /api/auth/login with demo credentials | Returns valid JWT |

## 5. Post-Deployment Validation

### 5.1 Smoke Test Checklist

#### System Health
- [ ] Health endpoint returns 200 with correct format
- [ ] No startup errors in logs
- [ ] Database connection established

#### Authentication Flow
- [ ] Login page loads
- [ ] Login with demo credentials succeeds
- [ ] JWT token stored in localStorage
- [ ] Protected routes accessible with token
- [ ] Logout clears token and redirects

#### Core Functionality
- [ ] Dashboard loads after login
- [ ] Projects list displays
- [ ] Create project succeeds
- [ ] File upload works
- [ ] Processing can be triggered

### 5.2 Critical User Journey: 5-Minute First-Run

| Step | Action | Expected Result | Max Time |
|------|--------|-----------------|----------|
| 1 | Login as demo user | Dashboard displays | 3s |
| 2 | Create new project | Project detail page | 2s |
| 3 | Upload CSV file | Source appears in list | 10s |
| 4 | Configure field mappings | Mappings saved | 5s |
| 5 | Enable de-identification | Privacy config saved | 3s |
| 6 | Start processing | Progress shown | 2s |
| 7 | Wait for completion | Status shows complete | 120s |
| 8 | Download JSONL export | File downloads | 5s |

**Total Target Time:** Under 5 minutes

### 5.3 Accessibility Validation Checklist

- [ ] Tab through entire app - all elements reachable
- [ ] No focus traps (except modals)
- [ ] All images have alt text
- [ ] All icon buttons have aria-labels
- [ ] Color contrast passes WCAG AA (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large)
- [ ] Screen reader can navigate all content
- [ ] Form errors announced to screen reader

### 5.4 Browser Compatibility Checklist

- [ ] Chrome (latest) - all features work
- [ ] Firefox (latest) - all features work
- [ ] Safari (latest) - all features work
- [ ] Mobile Safari (iOS) - critical flows work
- [ ] Mobile Chrome (Android) - critical flows work

### 5.5 Rollback Criteria

If any of these occur, initiate rollback immediately:
- [ ] Health endpoint returns 503 or non-200
- [ ] Login flow fails for all users
- [ ] Database connection errors persist in logs
- [ ] 500 errors on primary operations (project CRUD, file upload)
- [ ] Data isolation breach (cross-org data visible)

## Appendix B: Error Scenario Reference

| Error Code | HTTP Status | Trigger Condition | UI Recovery Action |
|------------|-------------|-------------------|-------------------|
| VALIDATION_ERROR | 400 | Invalid request body | Show field errors |
| INVALID_ID | 400 | Non-integer ID param | Show error message |
| INVALID_FILE_TYPE | 400 | Wrong file extension | Show allowed types |
| FILE_TOO_LARGE | 400 | File >50MB | Show size limit |
| INVALID_CREDENTIALS | 401 | Wrong email/password | Show generic error |
| UNAUTHORIZED | 401 | No/invalid token | Redirect to login |
| TOKEN_EXPIRED | 401 | Expired JWT | Clear token, redirect |
| ADMIN_REQUIRED | 403 | Member accessing admin route | Show permission error |
| NOT_FOUND | 404 | Resource doesn't exist | Show 404 page |
| INVITATION_NOT_FOUND | 404 | Invalid invite token | Show invalid link message |
| DUPLICATE_EMAIL | 409 | Email already registered | Show error on field |
| LAST_ADMIN | 409 | Removing only admin | Show warning |
| PROCESSING_IN_PROGRESS | 409 | Start while running | Show current status |
| INVITATION_EXPIRED | 422 | Token past expiry | Request new invitation |
| NO_SOURCES | 422 | Process without sources | Prompt to add source |
| RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED | 429 | Too many requests | Show countdown |
| INTERNAL_ERROR | 500 | Server error | Show retry option |
